gripOrHq.title: Encryption Breakthrough
gripOrHq.rulesText: All code gates have +1 strength. When you score Encryption Breakthrough, reveal as many code gates as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed code gate.

gripOrHq.title: Superior Net Barriers
gripOrHq.rulesText: All walls have +1 strength. When you score Superior Net Barriers, reveal as many walls as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed wall.

gripOrHq.title: Polymer Breakthrough
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [1] at the start of each of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Political Coup
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put [12] from the bank on Political Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Political Coup, if it has any bits.

gripOrHq.title: Holovid Campaign
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Holovid Campaign when you rez it. Take [1] from Holovid Campaign at the start of each of your turns. When all the bits have been removed, trash Holovid Campaign.

gripOrHq.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: D'Arc Knight
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

heapOrArchives.title: Management Shake-Up
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

discardCards.title: Taxman
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Tax counter. Every two Tax counters cause the Corp to lose [1] at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

discardCards.title: Viral Pipeline
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

discardCards.title: Remote Detonator
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on a data fort this turn. Trash all rezzed ice on that fort, and the Corp gives you three tags.

discardCards.title: Bolt-Hole
discardCards.rulesText: [T]: Prevent 2 meat damage. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

discardCards.title: R&D Mole
discardCards.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from R&D. Use this ability only when accessing cards from R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

discardCards.title: Faked Hit
discardCards.rulesText: Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. Take 2 brain damage. This damage cannot be prevented. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

discardCards.title: Subliminal Corruption
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point for each advertisement you trash during the run. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

discardCards.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

discardCards.title: Senatorial Field Trip
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if the Corp rezzed a piece of Black Ice this turn. The Corp either derezzes that piece of ice or receives 2 Bad Publicity points. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

rig.title: Crumble
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Crumble counter. Two or more Crumble counters allow you trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Omni Kismet, Ph.D.
root.rulesText: Swap a piece of unrezzed ice on this fort with an ice card stored in HQ. The new ice card comes into play concealed. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: D'Arc Knight
root.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Management Shake-Up
root.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

ice.title: Bolter Cluster
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 4 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

root.title: Political Coup
root.rulesText:
Put [12] from the bank on Political Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Political Coup, if it has any bits.
